decision_question: Does the canonical screening handoff distinguish the checkpoint evidence needed for a safe candidate handoff?
acceptance_criteria: Preserve the v1.0.0 read-only, exact-session and private-link boundaries.
Differentiate prepared, attempted-unverified and provider-confirmed saved progress.
Keep combined consent controls candidate-owned and application artifact correction separate.
Publish source and synthetic fixtures with version-specific evidence.

sources.basis: Sanitized workflow observations: role-specific saved checkpoints, a clarified current employment fact, a screening agreement whose label and destination differed, and a separate pending attachment correction.
Canonical read-only screening package from PR #166. v1.0.0 cases and review retained as historical design evidence.
Four synthetic development cases in checkpoint-cases-1.1.0.json.

candidate_decisions.basis: A screening has its own identity, chronology, candidate-owned gates and completion evidence.
Employer status, tracker writes and evidence coverage have a maintained workflow.
Submission and replacement require artifact-specific evidence and approval. Include the boundary as a regression case.

shared_model_or_source_limits: Read-only reviewer roles shared model family and static source set.
No candidate systems, behavioral fixture runs or protected holdout.

initial_reviews.finding: Historical evidence retains its v1.0.0 hash. Current fixtures trace the checkpoint and attachment distinctions.
Each checkpoint has a distinct candidate action. The mixed-control fixture needed explicit preparation evidence.
Read-only access, no personalized-link activation, exact-session verification and candidate-owned consent remain intact.

falsification_hypotheses: A save on screen B resolves a timeout on screen A.
A trusted origin makes combined save and recording administrative-only.
A screening receipt proves a prepared résumé correction was submitted.
test_results: The exact-session readback rule preserves A as attempted-unverified. The final fixture explicitly gives both sessions the same requisition.
The candidate-owned mixed-control rule holds on the verified session. The fixture explicitly records a local prepared answer and no observed save.
The correction remains separate, with the original attachment association intact.
disruptor.execution: Static falsification attempts against source and synthetic case design.

decisive_evidence: Final core and fixture hashes matched.
Both fixture clarifications are explicit and support observable expectations.
No surviving source defect within read-only scope.
unresolved_items: Runtime behavior, discovery metrics, installed host acceptance and unseen holdout remain unverified.

limitations: Source release only. Four new development cases are designed and inspected. Zero behavioral runs.
The v1.0.0 package review remains historical and cannot validate v1.1.0.

follow_up.condition: Before claiming live or installed-host behavior
follow_up.action: Run the exact version in authorized status-only environments with a protected external holdout.
